layout.arrangement: Title in a blue-bordered box top-left; yellow slide-number circle top-right. Left ~55% of slide is one large gray panel holding two vertical columns of airplane images, each column paired with a vertical strip of class labels (+1 pink strip, -1 green strip). Right ~40% is a stacked column: light-blue 'Activation Function' info box on top, then red heading 'Training' with a yellow rounded flowchart box, then red heading 'Evaluation' with a second yellow rounded flowchart box. Thin black strip across the very bottom edge.

regions.name: Title box
regions.content: White rectangle with blue border containing the blue bold title 'Training Samples with Labels   (Two Classes)'

regions.name: Slide number
regions.content: Yellow circle with thin dark outline containing black bold '19'

regions.name: Samples panel
regions.content: Gray panel with two class columns: Positive Class (red header, 5 enemy airplanes with skull emblems in a dark-red-bordered white box, pink '+1' label strip) and Negative Class (green header, 5 safe airplanes in a dark-red-bordered white box, green '-1' label strip)

regions.name: Activation Function box
regions.content: Light-blue box with blue border: three lines of text plus a pink circle containing a bipolar step-function glyph

regions.name: Training section
regions.content: Red bold heading 'Training' above a yellow rounded flowchart box: Input Sample → Model (with step icon) → Predicted Class → LOSS, plus 'Label of Input Sample' and '(+1, -1)'

regions.name: Evaluation section
regions.content: Red bold heading 'Evaluation' above a yellow rounded flowchart box: Test Sample → Model (with step icon) → Predicted Class → '(+1, -1)'

layout.hierarchy: The title box and the two airplane columns dominate visually (largest areas). Red 'Training'/'Evaluation' headings are the next most prominent text. Class headers (red/green bold) and '+1'/'-1' labels are medium; flowchart node labels and the yellow model captions are smallest. Color hierarchy: blue title, red/green class accents, dark-red model blocks, orange LOSS circle draw the eye in that order.

visual_elements.description: Title banner: white-filled rectangle with ~2pt blue border, centered bold blue text 'Training Samples with Labels   (Two Classes)'
Slide-number badge: yellow filled circle, thin dark outline, black bold numeral '19'

Two-class training-sample panel. Left column header: 'Positive Class' (red) over '"Shoot the Enemy"' (red); the word 'Label' in red sits to the right of this header. Below: white rectangle with ~3pt dark-red border containing 5 stacked line-art airplanes, each marked with a small skull-and-crossbones emblem. To its right: tall pink vertical strip with darker pink/red border containing bold red '+1' repeated 5 times, one aligned with each airplane. Right column header: 'Negative Class' (green) over '"Safe"' (green); the word 'Label' in green sits to the right of this header. Below: white rectangle with ~3pt dark-red border containing 5 stacked line-art airplanes with no emblems. To its right: tall light-green vertical strip with green border containing bold green '-1' repeated 5 times, one aligned with each airplane.
visual_elements.position: left half of slide, ~7%-58% width, ~17%-95% height

visual_elements.description: Activation Function info box: light-blue rectangle with blue border. Line 1: 'Activation Function' (blue). Line 2: 'Bi-polar step  (-1 , +1)' (blue). Line 3: 'Threshold at "zero"' (red). At the right edge inside the box: pink circle containing a dark-maroon bipolar step-function waveform (flat low segment, vertical jump at zero, flat high segment).

TRAINING flowchart inside a rounded light-yellow rectangle with orange border, left-to-right flow: black label 'Input Sample' at far left above a white block arrow (dark outline) pointing right; dark-red filled rectangle labeled 'Model' in white bold with small yellow caption '[Any value]  →   (-1 , +1)' beneath the word Model; a pink circle with dark-maroon bipolar step glyph overlaps the Model box's right edge; second white block arrow pointing right with black label 'Predicted Class' above it; orange filled circle labeled 'LOSS' in white bold; at far right, stacked black text 'Label of Input Sample' (three lines) with blue bold '(+1, -1)' beneath it, vertically aligned with the LOSS circle.

EVALUATION flowchart inside an identical rounded light-yellow rectangle with orange border, left-to-right flow: black label 'Test Sample' above a white block arrow pointing right; dark-red filled rectangle labeled 'Model' in white bold with small yellow caption '[Any value]  →   (-1 , +1)'; pink circle with dark-maroon bipolar step glyph overlapping the Model box's right edge; second white block arrow pointing right with black label 'Predicted Class' above it; blue bold '(+1, -1)' at the right end (no LOSS circle in this flow).

imagery: 5 hand-drawn cartoon airplanes (enemy class): white bodies, gray outlines, top-side view with cockpit windows and wing lines, each carrying a small black skull-and-crossbones emblem on the fuselage/wing; stacked vertically inside the dark-red-bordered white box in the left column of the samples panel

5 hand-drawn cartoon airplanes (safe class): same line-art style, no skull emblems; stacked vertically inside the dark-red-bordered white box in the right column of the samples panel; a small black mouse-cursor arrow (screen-capture artifact) overlaps the 2nd airplane from the top

3 pink circular icons containing a dark-maroon bipolar step-function waveform glyph (flat-low, vertical rise at zero, flat-high): one inside the Activation Function box, one overlapping each 'Model' block in the Training and Evaluation flowcharts
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title is bold blue, roughly 22-26pt, inside a bordered box. Section headings 'Training' and 'Evaluation' are bold red, ~18-20pt. Class headers ('Positive Class', 'Negative Class') are bold ~14pt in red/green with their quoted nicknames on a second line. '+1'/'-1' labels are bold ~14pt. Flowchart node labels ('Input Sample', 'Predicted Class', etc.) are black regular/bold ~11pt. Captions inside Model blocks are tiny (~8pt) yellow. '(+1, -1)' values are bold blue. No italics, no numbered bullets; quotation marks are used verbatim around 'Shoot the Enemy', 'Safe', and 'zero'.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built and static; no mid-build bullet reveal detected. A mouse cursor arrow is frozen over the 2nd airplane in the Negative Class column (screen-capture artifact, not slide content).
